items.source: Action to take when an uncaught ConfigDataNotFoundException is thrown.
items.translation: 当抛出未捕获的ConfigDataNotFoundException时应采取的操作。

items.source:
External configuration support allowing 'application.properties' to be loaded and used
within a Spring Boot application.
items.translation: 支持外部配置，允许在 Spring Boot 应用程序中加载并使用"application.properties"。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
